ranked_untried_candidates.name: Structure-conditioned conductive-ribbon anisotropy
ranked_untried_candidates.operator: At sigma 2 and 5 px, estimate an unoriented independent structural edge tangent from basement/potential-field gradients. Project the conductivity gradient into edge-normal and edge-parallel components. Feature = structural edge strength times positive cross-edge minus along-edge conductivity gradient energy, scale-normalized; combine the two scales with their pixelwise minimum.
ranked_untried_candidates.physical_signature: Narrow conductive damage/alteration ribbon parallel to an independent basement or potential-field boundary, with greater cross-edge than along-edge variation.
ranked_untried_candidates.missing_fault_rationale: A faulted and fluid-altered corridor under cover may form a narrow conductive ribbon even when the surface scarp is weak; independent structure-axis conditioning aims to reject broad conductive basin fill.
ranked_untried_candidates.difference_from_implemented: H-E tests local conductivity/basement/gravity co-location; H-H uses conductivity as a bridge between paired geophysical edge terminations. Neither projects conductivity-gradient energy into parallel/perpendicular components of an independent edge axis. Earlier K2/I descriptions were proposals only and have no measured outcome.
ranked_untried_candidates.expected_benefit: Qualitative low-to-moderate, uncertain; no numeric DTI forecast.
ranked_untried_candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; existing layers, directional transform, one six-fold paired run.

ranked_untried_candidates.name: Paired high-resolution scarp-face polarity balance
ranked_untried_candidates.operator: Normalized paired-face asymmetry (up-down)/(up+down+epsilon), absolute asymmetry, and adjacent-scale persistence conditioned on a coherent narrow lineament.
ranked_untried_candidates.physical_signature: One-sided displacement scarp with paired up/down-facing slopes and persistent trace geometry.
ranked_untried_candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Weathered fault scarps may preserve one-sided step morphology after absolute relief weakens.
ranked_untried_candidates.difference_from_implemented: H-D uses gradient-direction coherence, H-M cross-scale crest coincidence, and P1 odd/even detrended-elevation profiles at 200/500 m; this uses paired 1-m-DEM-derived face statistics. The related H51-X2 was proposed but not implemented or measured.
ranked_untried_candidates.expected_benefit: Qualitative low-to-moderate, uncertain; no numeric DTI forecast.

ranked_untried_candidates.name: Radiometric-composition break conditional on independent structure
ranked_untried_candidates.operator: After explicit finite/positive mask audit, compute local log(K/Th) and log(U/Th) cross-edge changes relative to along-edge changes at independent structure axes; missing/zero values are unknown, not absence.
ranked_untried_candidates.physical_signature: A narrow surface radiometric-composition boundary co-located with an independent subsurface structural edge.
ranked_untried_candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Hydrothermal alteration can modify near-surface radioelement distributions around fluid pathways, but radiometric data chiefly respond to surface composition and are not fault-specific.
ranked_untried_candidates.difference_from_implemented: No model feature uses a radiometric-ratio cross-versus-along contrast conditioned on a separate structural axis; earlier K3 ratio-lineament wording is unimplemented and not globally novel.
ranked_untried_candidates.expected_benefit: Qualitative low and highly uncertain; no numeric DTI forecast.
ranked_untried_candidates.implementation_cost: Medium-high; units, masks, ratio controls, and spatially blocked ablation.

ranked_untried_candidates.name: Sparse warm-water/geochemistry alignment with independent structure
layers: GDR 1391 well/spring temperature and chemistry records
ranked_untried_candidates.operator: Validate source identifiers and units; test whether multiple independently sampled warm/geochemically anomalous sites align along a narrow external edge more than matched controls. Do not rasterize a broad geothermal-habitat score.
ranked_untried_candidates.physical_signature: Sparse, source-verified geothermal-fluid manifestations aligned with an independent structural corridor.
ranked_untried_candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Faults may transmit geothermal fluids to springs or wells, but data collection and exploration are spatially selective.
ranked_untried_candidates.difference_from_implemented: Broad thermal/habitat layers and models exist; this is a point-conditioned alignment test. Earlier H51-X3 was proposed but not implemented or measured.
ranked_untried_candidates.expected_benefit: Qualitative low and uncertain; no numeric DTI forecast.
ranked_untried_candidates.implementation_cost: High; provenance, units, deduplication, selection-bias controls, spatially blocked joins.

locked_implementation_spec.candidate_model_arm: H-H plus exactly one H53-K2x feature; candidate prediction is 0.5 fresh H-D probability + 0.5 fresh H-H+K2x probability
locked_implementation_spec.input_semantics: Use existing globally empirical-rank-transformed competition feature layers, not physical-unit values. The cond_surf unit/depth/source are undocumented in the local GeoTIFF and organizer data download is login-walled. Do not claim S/m, resistivity, depth, salinity, alteration, or temperature.
locked_implementation_spec.derivatives: Use the repository normalised-convolution Gaussian derivative at each scale and the common finite mask of all four source layers and footprint.
locked_implementation_spec.edge_axis: For each of depth-to-base, isostatic gravity anomaly, and TMI, calculate gradient magnitude. Normalize each by its own deterministic row-major sampled 95th-percentile magnitude (sample at most approximately 200000 common valid pixels) and clip to [0,1]. Form a 2x2 unoriented gradient-normal tensor J=sum_j w_j*u_j*u_j^T, where u_j is the unit gradient vector, zero for magnitude <=1e-12. The normal angle is 0.5*atan2(2*Jxy,Jxx-Jyy), with tangent perpendicular.
locked_implementation_spec.edge_strength: Mean of the three clipped normalized magnitudes times axial tensor coherence sqrt((Jxx-Jyy)^2+4*Jxy^2)/(Jxx+Jyy+1e-12).
locked_implementation_spec.conductivity_contrast: Project the conductivity gradient onto the normal and tangent. Let anis=max(normal_projection^2-tangent_projection^2,0)/(gradient_magnitude^2+1e-12); let amplitude=clip(gradient_magnitude/q95_cond,0,1), where q95_cond uses the same deterministic sample rule. Per-scale feature=edge_strength*anis*amplitude.
locked_implementation_spec.scale_combination: Pixelwise minimum of the sigma=2 and sigma=5 per-scale features; NaN outside the intersection of their finite derivative masks. If a normalization q95 is <=1e-12, corresponding normalized strength is zero.
locked_implementation_spec.labels_used_by_feature: none; fold-safe static feature, computed from inputs only.
locked_implementation_spec.parameters_frozen_before_holdout: All scale, normalization, orientation, clipping, mask, and combination decisions above; no candidate-outcome tuning.

input_audit_status: Source/page review and local GeoTIFF semantic audit complete before feature code; see input audit receipt. Unit/depth/provenance unknown is handled by rank-only operator and explicit caveat, not inferred.
